full_prompt_en: A square architectural illustration portrays a waterfront performance building with several high, overlapping sail-shaped roof shells. The structure stretches across the middle of a warm cream paper field, with its largest pointed shells rising near the upper center and smaller curved roofs stepping down toward both ends. The shells are pale ivory, but fine dark hatching and blue-gray shadow fill their inward-facing sides, making their sweeping geometry easy to read. Below them, low ocher and terracotta volumes form terraces, glazed bands, and entrances along the quay. A narrow strip of water occupies the lower portion, reflecting dark strokes and warm building color in loose broken horizontal marks. Thin construction lines, perspective guides, and sketchy crosshatching remain visible around the edges, especially in the mostly open sky and at the lower left. A few tiny vertical marks near the base suggest people or posts, providing scale without becoming individual characters. The drawing is viewed from a low three-quarter angle across the water, showing both the long horizontal podium and the tall upward thrust of the roofs. Light appears to come from above and left, leaving cream highlights on the outer shells and deeper cool shade inside the curving openings. The paper texture and uneven ink line give the work a designed but hand-made character, while warm washes anchor the building against the pale background. There is no readable title or annotation in the selected view. The overall composition balances sculptural white arcs with a low warm base and restless waterline, combining technical observation with expressive architectural imagination.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅方形建筑插画表现一栋滨水演出建筑，其上有数片高高层叠的帆形屋顶外壳。建筑横贯暖奶油色纸面中部，最高尖壳升在上方中央附近，较小弯顶向两端逐渐降低。外壳为浅象牙色，但内向面填有细深排线和蓝灰阴影，使横扫的几何形易于辨认。其下，赭色与陶土色低矮体量沿码头形成露台、玻璃带和入口。下方一条窄水面用松散破碎的横向笔痕映出深线和暖色建筑。细构造线、透视辅助线与速写排线留在边缘，尤其在大体空白的天空和左下方可见。建筑基部几道极小竖痕暗示人或柱，提供尺度，却不成为具体角色。视点从水对岸的低位斜看，既能看清长水平台基，也能感到屋顶高高向上。光似乎从左上照来，使外侧壳面留奶油亮部，弯曲开口内保持更深冷影。纸张肌理和不均匀墨线让作品既有设计感也有手工性，暖洗色则把建筑稳在浅背景前。所选画面没有可读标题或注记。整体构图以雕塑般白弧平衡低矮暖色基座与跃动水线，把技术观察和富表现力的建筑想象结合。
style_prompt_en: The image uses hand-drawn architectural illustration with long sweeping shelllike curves over a low rectilinear base. Cream paper, warm ocher wash, charcoal ink, and cool blue-gray hatching form a restrained technical palette. Fine construction lines remain visible beside darker final contours, revealing the layered design process without overwhelming the focal geometry. Sunlit outer planes stay pale, while dense hatching deepens inward surfaces; loose horizontal strokes below counter the upward arcs. Large open areas of paper give the complex structure room to breathe. The overall effect is sculptural, analytical, and lively with the motion of the drawing hand.
style_prompt_zh: 图像采用手绘建筑插画，以长而横扫的壳状弧线立于低矮直线基座上。奶油纸色、暖赭洗色、炭黑墨线和冷蓝灰排线构成克制的技术配色。细构造线留在较深的最终轮廓旁，显露层叠设计过程，却不压倒焦点几何形。受光外平面保持浅色，密排线加深内向表面；下方松散横笔痕平衡向上的弧线。大片空纸让复杂结构有呼吸余地。整体效果雕塑化、分析式，并带着画笔运动的活力。
theme_en: A waterfront opera house with layered sail-shaped roofs in an architectural drawing
theme_zh: 建筑手绘中的滨水歌剧院具有层叠帆形屋顶
name: Jorn Utzon
